To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we have designed and analyzed a provably good parallel race detector, Nondeterminator, (2) we have shown that Nondeterminator runs in nearly optimal time, (3) we have shown how to maintain the series parallel relationships “on the ﬂy” for multithreaded fork-join programs, and (4) we have shown a lower bound on the running time of any parallel race detection algorithm.
